name: sid
description: Preserves users states across page requests.

name: __cq_dnt
description: This opt-out cookie identifies if the visitor has deselected any cookies, trackers or other audience targeting tools.

name: dw_dnt
description: Collects information on user preferences and/or interaction with web-campaign content - This is used on CRM-campaign-platform used by website owners for promoting events or products.

name: dwsid
description: This cookie is set to count the number of times a specific visitor is shown a specific ad – the cookie enables the advertisers to differentiate the specific ads shown and thereby making the advertising more efficient.

name: __cf_bm
description: This cookie is used to distinguish between humans and bots. This is beneficial for the website, in order to make valid reports on the use of their website.

name: _ga
description: Registers a unique ID that is used to generate statistical data on how the visitor uses the website.

name: CookieConsent
description: Stores the user's cookie consent state for the current domain

name: _ga_5LFE5NKM4G
description: Used by Google Analytics to collect data on the number of times a user has visited the website as well as dates for the first and most recent visit.

name: weird_get_top_level_domain
description: The cookie determines the preferred language and country-setting of the visitor - This allows the website to show content most relevant to that region and language.

name: dwanonymous_UID{32}
description: This cookie contains a specific ID on the visitor in order to distinguish visitors. This information allows the website to remember the visitor’s preferences, settings and secures the functionality of the shopping basket.
